facts.text: Serve the mains when the misfit team finally sits down together.
facts.why: The plot summary and quote page opened show the team escaping the vault, travelling, being captured by Bucky and fighting the Void. They do not describe a sit down meal. The one food moment on the quote page is John Walker offering cactus berries in the desert.
facts.fix: Serve the mains when John Walker asks 'Anybody hungry?' and hands round the cactus berries.

facts.text: Bob, eat. Nobody here is okay. We're all hungry.
facts.why: A note in Yelena's voice, not a quote. It fits the film: she talks Bob through feeling hollow and the team ends up hugging him. Keep it without quote marks. It is not printed on the single face.

facts.text: Alexei's way, jam stirred in, no arguing.
facts.why: Alexei (Red Guardian) is a Russian father figure to Yelena, but no source opened shows him with tea and jam. Could not confirm.
Valentina sends her operatives on jobs and wants to wipe the slate clean, but 'stolen jobs' is vague and no source opened uses it.

vibe.verdict: A neat ration sheet in the right grey and blue, but the film's funniest food beats (cactus berries, the soccer team) are missing.
missing: Peewee soccer team, West Chesapeake Valley Thunderbolts (the name)
The group hug that beats the Void (finale)
The incinerator trap in the vault (opening)
The Void's black darkness over New York
ideas: Swap 'Bob's Void black sesame cookies' note for a hug line
Rename 'Nut, apricot and chocolate trail mix' to 'Walker's cactus berry mix'
Replace 'Vault escape smash burger sliders' note with the incinerator countdown
Add a Thunderbolts soccer team patch, Shane's Tire Shop, to the badge
